name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois's journey into motorsport began with a lifelong fascination for Formula 1, fueled by family trips to the French Grand Prix. After completing her degree in Human Resources Management at ESSEC Business School, she sought to combine her professional skills with her passion. She started in a junior HR role at a smaller racing team before progressing to Richard Childress Racing. Sophie excels in fostering a supportive and inclusive team environment, implementing strategies to attract top talent, and ensuring fair and equitable practices across the organization. Her data-driven approach and unwavering commitment to employee well-being set her apart, making her a valuable asset to the team.

She believes that a well-supported team is a winning team, and her focus is on providing resources and development opportunities for staff members. Sophie is very keen on diversity and inclusion and is always looking for ways to give opportunities to those that may not normally get them. Her ambition is to see RCR as a leader in motorsport, not just on the track, but in the workplace as well.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back in a neat ponytail.
physical.description: Sophie is of average height with a warm, welcoming smile that puts people at ease.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized desk, with color-coded files.
Starts every meeting with a brief mindfulness exercise.
Secretly sketches racing car designs during her lunch break.
